identity_rule: A reference is identified by identity.sha256 of the image bytes; current_path is informational and may change when the Owner moves a file.

seller_concentration.rule: When one seller supplies more than 60% of the retrieved references, only transferable_lessons reach the brief; seller identity facets are stripped.

weighting.performance: Campaign performance is stored separately and never changes owner_status or owner_weight.
